verdict.rationale: Lovable's docs confirm you can export/sync code to GitHub/GitLab, work locally, and 'deploy outside Lovable' (lovable-docs-14, lovable-docs-20, lovable-docs-9, lovable-docs-33), and also offers a direct code download (lovable-docs-10, lovable-docs-35). This gives developers a path to self-host, but Lovable itself has no native one-click deploy target beyond its own hosting (custom domain is still on Lovable's platform per lovable-docs-12/15/22), so external deployment relies entirely on manual export. Missing for 10: first-party deploy integrations to common external hosts (Vercel/Netlify/AWS), independent hands-on confirmation of a successful external deployment workflow.
